news.summary: Earlier this year, Optum Rx teased the rollout of new pharmacy tools designed to address medication cost and access.

news.summary: Uncompensated care and cost pressures haven't gone away for hospitals, leading to a “historically large portion” of the nation’s hospitals running on negative or near-zero operating margins, Kaufman Hall warned in its latest industry benchmark.

news.title: Humana launches national provider Gold Card program
news.summary: Humana is continuing its push to reform prior authorization with the launch of a national provider gold card program, which will initially focus on MRI, CT and MRA imaging as well as physical and occupational therapy.

news.title: HLTH 2026: GLP-1 costs remain a challenge. A new CVS study aims to identify the right price
news.summary: Cost and access to GLP-1s remains a challenge, but the benefits of these drugs aren't in doubt. A new study from CVS Health aims to quantify at what price a GLP-1 drug has generated enough savings elsewhere through improved clinical outcomes.

news.title: FDA’s complete response letter for Summit’s ivonescimab cites China-heavy data beyond survival miss
news.summary: The FDA’s rejection of Summit Therapeutics’ closely watched PD-1xVEGF bispecific ivonescimab extends beyond its previously reported failure to show a statistically significant overall survival benefit.

news.title: Scientists uncover ‘very detailed map’ of an enzyme target for rare metabolic disease
news.summary: For some rare genetic diseases, the problem isn't a missing protein but the buildup of toxic molecules that the body can no longer clear away.

news.title: Medtronic pays $380M-plus for Contego Medical buyout
news.summary: Medtronic is boosting its cardiovascular disease portfolio with a deal to buy up carotid artery disease and peripheral thrombectomy tech company Contego Medical.

news.title: Kyntra axes mid-stage ADC, adding to years of stumbles
news.summary: Beleaguered Kyntra Bio can’t catch a break. Formerly known as FibroGen, the company has endured a series of woes over the last few years, and now the biotech is cutting a clinical antibody-drug conjugate program from its mid-stage lineup.

news.title: Why 2027 could be ‘Europe’s year to shine’: Panelists debate biotech funding at Fierce’s London event
news.summary: Panelists at Fierce Biotech's London Life Sciences Week event discussed whether Europe can pull its weight in biopharma investment next year against the gravitational pull of the U.S. and China.

news.title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B series C months after $2.1B round
news.summary: Isomorphic Labs has raised a $5 billion series C round, marking the second time in six months that the AI drug development startup has pulled off a multibillion-dollar financing.

news.title: AriBio’s oral Alzheimer’s drug meets monotherapy goal in phase 3 as Fosun weighs licensing option
news.summary: AriBio’s erectile dysfunction med-turned Alzheimer’s disease candidate mirodenafil has delivered some mixed results from a global phase 3 trial. Fosun Pharma has an option to in-license the PDE5 inhibitor.

news.title: Sellas marks 9-month survival benefit in late-stage leukemia vaccine study
news.summary: Sellas Life Sciences’ cancer vaccine for acute myeloid leukemia has passed a phase 3 test with a more than nine-month improvement in overall survival.

news.title: Marrow extracts $120M series B to advance preclinical blood disease therapy
news.summary: A new biotech targeting blood disorders, aptly called Marrow Therapeutics, has launched with $173 million in combined funding and a preclinical lead program aimed at sickle cell disease and beta thalassemia.

news.title: Lilly signs $5.9B deal with Stipple to unlock oncology targets
news.summary: Eli Lilly has struck a $5.9 billion deal to partner with Stipple Bio on oncology drug candidates that more precisely target tumor cells.

news.title: CG preps new, expanded bladder cancer plans with FDA after ph. 3 win
news.summary: CG Oncology showed in a late-stage study that its immunotherapy cretostimogene reduced the risk of tumor recurrence in certain patients with non-muscle invasive bladder cancer following surgery.

papers.title: Breath-Dx: A Time Series Classification Benchmark for Disease Screening with eNose
papers.summary: Electronic nose (eNose) technology offers a portable, non-invasive route for disease screening via exhaled breath analysis. However, progress in the field is hindered by the lack of systematic benchmarks that compare machine learning methods under realistic conditions, particularly sensor drift, a known but rarely quantified failure mode. Most existing studies rely on small, private datasets with inconsistent protocols, rendering results non-comparable and slowing progress. papers.title: MedJev: A System One Vision-Language Decision Model for Fast and Effective Medical Image Understanding
papers.summary: Medical image understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) typically relies on autoregressively generating reasoning and answer tokens. These unnecessary tokens make the inference cost scale with the response length and force the answer to be parsed from free-form text, incurring avoidable latency and decision errors. papers.title: Flexible Multi-Stack Super-Resolution of Clinical Brain MRI Using Hetero-Orientation Variational Encoding: Expert Reader Evaluation in a Nigerian Cohort
papers.summary: High-resolution brain MRI is important for neuroradiological assessment, yet routine clinical protocols often rely on fast, anisotropic 2D acquisitions, particularly in resource-constrained settings. These acquisitions may differ in orientation, alignment and anatomical coverage, resulting in partially overlapping image stacks. Existing learning-based super-resolution methods typically rely on single, under-constrained inputs or fixed multi-stack configurations with idealised acquisition geometry. papers.title: InclusionMed: Benchmarking AI for Inclusive Healthcare
papers.summary: Advancing medical AI for inclusive healthcare requires evaluation across diverse healthcare roles, tasks, and care settings, but benchmark coverage remains uneven.
